findings.title: Unvalidated input reaches the database query
findings.evidence: The handler passes `req.query.q` straight into `db.query`, so a caller controls the SQL text.
findings.suggestedFix: Bind the value as a parameter and reject unsupported characters.

findings.title: Missing test for the new error path
findings.evidence: The new branch returns a 400 response but no test covers it.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a test that sends an invalid query and asserts the 400 response.

findings.title: Redundant null check
findings.evidence: `value` is already narrowed to a string above, so the check always passes.
